newsitem.title: USA: Redbook sales said up 0.8 pct period ending Jan 25.
newsitem.headline: Redbook sales said up 0.8 pct period ending Jan 25.

text.p: The Redbook Retail Sales Index is expected to rise by 0.8 percent in the period ending January 25 from the 0.3 percent rise seen in the prior period, according to market rumors cited in a report by MMS International.
MMS said the report was not expected to have that large a negative effect on the gains seen in Treasuries this session.
A trader who asked not to be named also cited the rumoured increase of 0.8 percent.
Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc will report the Redbook Index at 1455 EST/1955 GMT.
